identity_scope: Restrict the investigation to the three supplied N-phenyl pyrazolone identities and their source solution optical observations. Preserve heavy-atom connectivity, total stoichiometry and explicit charge/state accounting in any derived representation. The supplied valence drawings are identity encodings and do not establish a unique solution species or configuration. Absorption in CHCl3/DMF, NMR in CDCl3/DMSO-d6 and solid-state IR have different environments; do not merge their conditions. The NH-pyrazolone series, antimicrobial assays, cell imaging and bulk fluorescence are outside the question. The 7a14.07ppm NMR solvent provenance is unresolved between main p14 and SI p155; preserve this limitation when using that datum.
